heading.en: Birth and years as crown prince

body.zh-Hant: 純宗於1874年2月8日生於昌德宮觀物軒，是高宗與明成皇后之子，名坧，號正軒。1875年高宗表示要冊封他為世子，2月18日在昌德宮仁政殿舉行冊封儀式。1897年高宗還駕慶運宮、宣布建立大韓帝國，他隨之被冊封為皇太子。
body.en: Sunjong was born on 8 February 1874 at Gwanmulheon in Changdeok Palace, a son of Gojong and Empress Myeongseong; his personal name was Cheok and his pen name Jeongheon. In 1875 Gojong announced that he would invest him as crown prince, and the investiture ceremony was held on 18 February at Injeongjeon Hall of Changdeok Palace. In 1897, when Gojong returned to Gyeongun Palace and proclaimed the Korean Empire, he was invested as imperial crown prince.

citations.quote: 순종은 1874년(고종 11) 2월 8일 창덕궁의 관물헌(觀物軒)에서
고종(高宗)과 명성황후(明成皇后, 閔妃) 사이에서 태어났다
이름은 척(坧), 자는 군방(君邦)이며, 호는 정헌(正軒)이다
1875년(고종 12) 1월 1일에 고종은 순종을 세자에 책봉하겠다는 의사를 표명하였다
2월 18일 창덕궁 인정전(昌德宮 仁政殿)에서 순종의 세자 책봉의식이 거행되었다
1897년 고종이 경운궁(慶運宮, 덕수궁의 옛 이름)으로 환어(還御)하여 황제에 올라
대한제국을 선포함에 따라 순종은 황태자로, 세자빈은 황태자비로 책봉되었다

body.zh-Hant: 1907年7月19日，純宗代高宗開始代理聽政；7月24日日本強迫簽訂韓日新協約，使統監得以干預國政全般。8月27日他在慶運宮惇德殿舉行皇帝即位典禮，年號定為隆熙。9月7日又公布冊封英親王李垠為皇太子。
body.en: On 19 July 1907 Sunjong began acting for Gojong as regent. On 24 July Japan forced through the new Korea-Japan agreement, which let the Resident-General interfere in all affairs of state. On 27 August he held his enthronement ceremony at Dondeokjeon Hall in Gyeongun Palace, and the era name was set as Yunghui. On 7 September it was announced that Prince Yeongchin, Yi Eun, would be made crown prince.

citations.quote: 1907년 7월 19일 순종은 고종을 대신해 대리청정(代理聽政)을 시작하였으며
1907년 7월 24일 소위 한일신협약(韓日新協約) 또는 정미7조약(丁未七條約)을 강제하여
통감이 조선의 국정 전반을 간섭할 수 있게 됨은 물론
8월 27일 순종은 경운궁 돈덕전(惇德殿)에 나아가 황제즉위식을 치렀으며
연호는 융희(隆熙)로 정하였다

한 달 후인 9월 7일 이를 선포하여 만방에 알렸다

heading.en: A nominal emperor and the royal tours

body.zh-Hant: 1909年1月7日起，純宗到大邱、釜山、馬山一帶巡幸六夜七日；1月27日起又巡行西北地方，至2月3日為止。同年7月12日簽訂己酉覺書，把大韓帝國的司法與監獄業務委託給日本政府。10月26日伊藤博文在哈爾濱被安重根射殺。國史編纂委員會的解說認為，純宗在位期間君主權受到限制，沒有行使什麼實權。
body.en: From 7 January 1909 Sunjong toured Daegu, Busan and Masan for six nights and seven days; from 27 January he toured the north-west until 3 February. On 12 July 1909 the Giyu Memorandum was concluded, entrusting Korea's judicial and prison affairs to the Japanese government. On 26 October Ito Hirobumi was shot dead at Harbin by An Jung-geun. The National Institute of Korean History commentary says that during his reign the monarch's powers were restricted and he exercised no real authority.

citations.quote: 1909년 1월 7일부터 13일까지 6박 7일간 순종은 대구, 부산, 마산 등지를
서북지방을 돌아보는 서순행(西巡幸)에 나서 2월 3일까지 7박 8일간
1909년 7월 12일 대한제국의 사법과 감옥 업무를 일본정부에게 위탁하는 것을
10월 26일 이토가 러시아 재무상(財務相) 코코프체프(V. N. Kokovsev)와
대한의군사령관이었던 안중근(安重根)이 이토를 저격, 3발을 명중시켜 사살하였다
군주권은 제약당하며 별다른 실권을 행사하지 못하였다

heading.en: Annexation and the years as Yi Wang

body.zh-Hant: 1910年8月22日簽訂韓日合併條約，8月29日條約成立、大韓帝國滅亡。日本把大韓帝國改名為朝鮮，稱高宗為李太王、純宗為李王，純宗仍居昌德宮度過晚年。1926年4月25日他在昌德宮大造殿去世，享年五十三歲，葬於南楊州市金谷的裕陵。
body.en: The Korea-Japan annexation treaty was signed on 22 August 1910, and on 29 August it was brought into force and the Korean Empire ended. Japan renamed the Korean Empire "Joseon" and had Gojong styled Yi Taewang and Sunjong styled Yi Wang; Sunjong spent his later years at Changdeok Palace. He died on 25 April 1926 in Daejojeon Hall of Changdeok Palace at the age of 53 and was buried at Yureung in Geumgok, Namyangju.

heading.en: Family background and entry to Parliament

body.zh-Hant: 史丹利·鮑德溫生於1867年。他的父系是富裕的實業家，他協助父親經營自1902年起成為英國最大鋼鐵公司之一的鮑德溫公司；母系有藝術與文學背景，吉卜林是他的表親。父親阿爾弗雷德自1892年起是保守黨的西伍斯特郡（比德利）議員，1908年父親去世後，鮑德溫接任議員席位；議會記錄載他自1908年2月29日起代表比德利選區。
body.en: Stanley Baldwin was born in 1867. His father's family were wealthy industrialists and he helped his father build Baldwins Ltd, from 1902 one of Britain's largest iron and steel firms; his mother's family had artistic and literary interests, and Rudyard Kipling was a cousin. His father Alfred was Conservative MP for West Worcestershire (Bewdley) from 1892, and when Alfred died in 1908 Baldwin succeeded him; Hansard records him sitting for Bewdley from 29 February 1908.

heading.zh-Hant: 財政官員、財政大臣與首次出任首相

body.zh-Hant: 1917年他在勞合·喬治的戰時聯合政府出任財政部財政秘書，議會記錄載任期至1921年；1921至1922年任商務大臣。1922年他在卡爾頓俱樂部會議的關鍵發言促成勞合·喬治政府垮台，隨後出任財政大臣，記錄載1922至1923年。1923年5月博納·勞因病退休，鮑德溫出任首相，議會記錄載任期自1923年5月22日至1924年1月21日。
body.en: In 1917 he became Financial Secretary to the Treasury in Lloyd George's wartime coalition, a post Hansard dates to 1921; he was President of the Board of Trade in 1921-1922. His key speech at the Carlton Club meeting in 1922 brought down Lloyd George, after which he served as Chancellor of the Exchequer, recorded as 1922-1923. When Bonar Law retired through illness in May 1923 Baldwin became Prime Minister, and Hansard gives his term as 22 May 1923 to 21 January 1924.

body.zh-Hant: 1924年10月大選使第一屆工黨政府倒台後，他再度出任首相，議會記錄載此任期自1924年11月4日至1929年6月4日。這屆保守黨政府的成就包括《洛迦諾公約》、擴大養老金與住宅興建，以及地方政府改革與讓21歲以上婦女取得投票權。1926年5月面對總罷工時，他以堅定與調和並用的方式使罷工失敗。
body.en: After the first Labour government was defeated in the October 1924 general election he returned as Prime Minister, and Hansard gives this term as 4 November 1924 to 4 June 1929. His second Conservative government's achievements included the Locarno pact, expansion of pensions and house building, local government reform and votes for women over 21. Faced with the General Strike in May 1926, he combined firmness and conciliation to defeat it.

heading.zh-Hant: 在野、樞密院議長與第三任首相
heading.en: Opposition, Lord President and third premiership

body.zh-Hant: 1929年5月保守黨選敗後，他面對嚴重的黨內危機。1931年財政與政治危機中，他促成聯合政府成立，在聯合政府任樞密院議長，議會記錄載任期1931至1935年，並於1932至1934年兼任掌璽大臣。1935年6月7日他再任首相至1937年5月27日；1937年5月自政府與政黨政治退休，受封比德利的鮑德溫伯爵。
body.en: After the Conservatives lost the May 1929 election he endured a severe party crisis. During the financial and political crisis of 1931 he contributed to the formation of a coalition government and served as Lord President of the Council, a post Hansard dates 1931-1935, and as Lord Privy Seal in 1932-1934. He became Prime Minister again on 7 June 1935 and served until 27 May 1937; on retiring from government and party politics in May 1937 he was created Earl Baldwin of Bewdley.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館的權威檔把尼古拉·穆沙諾夫記為保加利亞政治家，生於1872年4月12日，出生地是德里亞諾沃，卒於1951年5月10日，卒地是索菲亞。美國國會圖書館名稱權威檔記他的姓名為「Мушанов, Никола」，生卒日期同為1872年4月12日與1951年5月10日。
body.en: The German National Library authority record describes Nikola Mushanov as a Bulgarian politician, born on 12 April 1872 in Dryanovo and died on 10 May 1951 in Sofia. The Library of Congress name authority file gives his name as "Мушанов, Никола" and the same birth and death dates, 12 April 1872 and 10 May 1951.
